name: Cummins Inc.
research_rationale: Quarterly filings show strong earnings and cash flow, supporting the screen buy, but recent price weakness and a lower Morgan Stanley target keep conviction measured.

weekly_updates.summary:
Nov news highlights Q3 earnings follow-through, a reported one-year share-price low, and Morgan Stanley maintaining coverage while cutting its target to $588.
Quarterly sources still show resilient 2026 revenue, rising diluted EPS, and TTM free cash flow of about $3.5bn; filing risk themes are unchanged.
Institutional flow headlines are mixed; sentiment pieces do not add new fundamental disclosure beyond existing SEC and news summaries.
